title: Departure
description:
The world of programming doesn't end with blocks and Karol code. Most software is developed in a "big" programming language, and this is your chance to get to know such a language!

**Work on the script on the left and click on Start 🚀**

Accidentally deleted too much? Reset your program via the menu 🔄
questScript:
__ide_prompt("Your first Python script is being executed. Are you excited?", "Yes, let's go!")

__ide_run_client()

__ide_sleep(0.4)

stdout = __ide_get_outputs()

if len(stdout) == 0:
    __ide_prompt("You didn't print anything. `" +
                 "Use the `print()` command in your program.",
                 "Close")
    __ide_exit()

if len(stdout) > 1:
    __ide_prompt("Please print only one text.", "Close")
    __ide_exit()

if not stdout[0].strip().lower() == "hello, python!":
    __ide_prompt("You printed a text, but something isn't right yet.", "Fix it")
    __ide_exit()

__ide_set_progress(True)
__ide_prompt("Perfectly done 🎉 In the right window you can see your output.", "Yes, I've seen it")
program:
# Change the output to "Hello, Python!"

print("lalala")
